text:
Why Anthropic default Claude Code to use 1 hour cache tier at 2x cost?

If Claude Code use 5 mins cache tier at 1.25x + auto refresh at 0.1x cost, we can get up to 40 minutes of warm cache, charged at 0.1x cost increments for the price of a fixed 1 hour cache.

Boris Cherny
